posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif wished director Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid ongoing rumors of a rift between them, sparking Bollywood gossip about their professional relationship.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh continues to dominate with his 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' trailer and 'Kya Kamaal Hai' music collaboration, while Ektaa Kapoor called the Imtiaz Ali film 'emotional and timeless.'

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt returned from Cannes 2026 and was spotted at Mumbai airport wearing a 'TIRED' T-shirt, dodging paparazzi after being trolled on social media for her Cannes appearance and India's Got Latent rumors.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra Jonas returns to Indian cinema with SS Rajamouli's mega-budget 'Varanasi' alongside Mahesh Babu, currently in production for an April 2027 release.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's upcoming film 'King' faces AI-generated leaks prompting security measures, while KKR pushes for IPL 2026 playoffs and rumors swirl about a 'Main Hoon Na 2' reunion with Farah Khan.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor is set to reunite with Salman Khan in a superhero film directed by Raj & DK, with filming expected to begin in October 2026 for a 2027 release.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor announced the animated film 'Chhoti Stree' exploring Stree's backstory ahead of Stree 3, and is in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' mythological drama 'Mahavatar.'

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone is using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's 'Raka' and SRK's 'King' due to her pregnancy, while Sai Pallavi has replaced her in Kalki 2 over creative differences.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 has crossed ₹1,800 crore globally making it the first Hindi film to top ₹1,000 crore net, with its OTT premiere on JioHotstar set for June 4. Ranveer's next film 'Pralay' begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai dominated Cannes 2026 with three stunning looks — a sapphire Amit Aggarwal gown, blush pink Sophie Couture, and a white Cheney Chan power suit — marking her 24th appearance with daughter Aaradhya by her side.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna unveiled a fierce, blood-soaked first look for her upcoming film 'Mysaa,' calling it a 'never-seen-before' role. Meanwhile, a leaked 'Cocktail 2' song was swiftly deleted from platforms.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu is producing and starring in 'Maa Inti Bangaram,' which has landed Gulshan Devaiah for his big Telugu debut fresh off his Kantara: Chapter 1 success.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun confirmed a new collaboration with Malayalam director Basil Joseph (not the shelved Shaktimaan project), and shared photos meeting RCB cricketer Venkatesh Iyer after an IPL 2026 match in Hyderabad.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' is set for a June 4 global release with AR Rahman performing live at a Bhopal concert. He also apologized to Jasprit Bumrah after accidentally calling him a 'footballer' at the Peddi event.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' glimpse with Prashanth Neel shattered records with 64M+ YouTube views in 24 hours. He has confirmed a four-film lineup including War 2, Dragon, Devara 2, and a Nelson Dilipkumar project.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor is on a promo blitz for 'Peddi' with Ram Charan — the AR Rahman-scored sports drama has broken runtime records at 3 hours 9 minutes and hits theaters June 4.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's romantic drama 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya opened at ₹3.31 crore and is getting a BOGO ticket push to target youth audiences after strong chemistry reviews.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra announced their pregnancy! She also shut down rumors about requesting cuts in 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups,' calling the claims 'absolute nonsense.'

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan was the target of a celebrity death hoax that went viral on May 23, quickly debunked by fans. Meanwhile, Krrish 4 remains in limbo over a VFX disagreement with Yash Raj Films.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's father David Dhawan broke down at the emotional trailer launch of 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai,' saying 'everyone deserves a son like Varun.' The rom-com has been postponed to June 12.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's 'All Hearts Tour' and 'Unstoppable Tour' dates are rolling out for 2026 across the US, with Boston shows in September already generating huge fan excitement.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed live at the 'Peddi Ki Aawaz' concert in Bhopal with Ram Charan, and called his collaboration with Hans Zimmer on the ₹4,000 crore 'Ramayana' soundtrack a 'great honour.'

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay turned 51 on May 25 as his final film 'Jana Nayagan' still awaits CBFC certification. Producer Venkat Narayana says the release date will be announced once clearance arrives.
